visuals: A breathtaking panoramic view of the Swiss Alps with snow-capped peaks, a lush green valley, and a small alpine village nestled between the mountains. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Its scenery? Total postcard perfection. Think snow-tipped Alps, deep green forests, sparkling rivers, and cozy valleys. No wonder it’s called the roof of Europe!

visuals: The wide Rhine River winding through green hills near the Swiss border, with a clear blue sky and distant mountains. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: One amazing natural star is the Rhine River. It begins here and zooms through Germany all the way to the sea. That’s one long water ride!

visuals: The Bundesplatz in Bern in Switzerland bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Speaking of things that stand tall, meet Switzerland’s national flower: the edelweiss. It grows high up in rocky mountain spots and even stars in songs!

visuals: A small red squirrel with a bushy tail sitting on a pine tree branch in a Swiss forest. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: You might see red squirrels darting through trees.

visuals: A majestic Alpine ibex with large curved horns standing on a steep rocky slope in the Swiss Alps. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Or alpine ibex climbing cliffs like pros.

visuals: A parade of Swiss cows wearing large decorative bells and floral crowns, walking down a mountain path during a traditional festival. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But here’s a fun one: some cows wear giant bells and get paraded down the mountain at the end of summer!

visuals: A view of the old town of Bern, Switzerland, with its historic clock tower (Zytglogge) and the Bear Park enclosure by the Aare River. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Ready to visit the capital? It’s Bern! It’s peaceful and has its very own Bear Park, where bears live safely in a big, natural enclosure right in the city.

visuals: The modern Zurich skyline in Switzerland at sunset, with its clean streets and the Limmat River flowing into Lake Zurich. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now scoot over to Zurich! it's known for clean streets and being a major hub for Swiss banking.

visuals: The impressive Jet d’Eau fountain in Geneva, Switzerland, shooting a massive jet of water high into the air over Lake Geneva. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Then splash into Geneva, home to the famous Jet d’Eau fountain that shoots water almost 500 feet in the air!

visuals: The Chapel Bridge area in Lucerne in Switzerland bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Switzerland is full of voices: literally! It has four official languages: German, French, Italian, and Romansh. Different regions speak different ones. Say “hello” with hallo, bonjour, ciao, or allegra!

visuals: The Bundesplatz in Bern in Switzerland bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Speaking of people, about 9 million live here. That’s a similar number to the population of Mexico City. Small country, big impact!

visuals: A traditional Swiss cheese fondue in a ceramic pot (caquelon) with bread cubes on long metal forks being dipped into the melted cheese. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Now for my favorite part: food! Ever tried cheese fondue? It’s warm, melted cheese in a big pot, and you dip in bread. Cozy, right?

visuals: Lake Geneva promenade in Switzerland bustling with people and inhabitants. Open space, not closed. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Don’t forget rösti: it’s like a golden, crispy hash brown, often eaten for breakfast or lunch in the German-speaking areas.

visuals: A variety of high-quality Swiss chocolate bars and truffles arranged on a clean surface, with some pieces broken to show the creamy texture. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And the chocolate? Swiss chocolate is known around the world for being super smooth, creamy, and rich in flavor. Just one bite and you’ll see why!

visuals: A Swiss man in traditional alpine attire yodeling from a grassy hilltop with the majestic Alps in the background. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Music time! Yodeling isn’t just fun to say! it’s a kind of singing that jumps up and down, like an echo through the mountains.

visuals: The lively Basel Carnival (Fasnacht) in Switzerland, with people in elaborate costumes and masks playing flutes and drums in a parade. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Add in the colorful Basel Carnival in spring, and you’ve got a party with costumes, parades, and music everywhere!

visuals: A historic image of the 1954 World Cup final in Switzerland, showing the scoreboard and players in action. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Guess what? Switzerland hosted the 1954 World Cup! The final had nine goals! A record for the most ever scored in a championship game. That’s soccer history!

visuals: Swiss tennis legend Roger Federer celebrating a victory on a grass court. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: Sports fans, check this out: Roger Federer, one of tennis’s greatest players, is from here!

visuals: Swiss skier Lara Gut-Behrami racing down a snowy mountain slope in her national team uniform. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: And skier Lara Gut-Behrami is a top athlete who races down snowy slopes in the Alps.

visuals: A modern red Swiss train traveling on a winding mountain track over a scenic stone viaduct in the Alps. No text, no signs, no written words.
script: But wait, there’s more! Swiss trains are so on time, you could set your watch by them. And yes, even turtles get special bridges to cross highways safely. Who knew?
